events.body:
## Context

`public/js/consent.js` (about L119-131) builds CSV cells from user-entered name, details and purpose, escaping only `"`. A value starting with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` runs as a formula in Excel or LibreOffice (OWASP "CSV Injection"). The CSV export also leaves out `participants`, which the JSON export includes.

## What to do

1. Add a `csvCell(v)` helper that prefixes `'` when a value starts with `= + - @ \t \r`, then quotes and doubles `"`. Use it for every column.
2. Add a Participants column.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An entry named `=HYPERLINK("x")` exports as text
- [ ] CSV has a participants column
- [ ] JSON export unchanged

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-safecloak && npx wrangler dev   # /consent > record > Export CSV > open in LibreOffice
```

---
